# Securiq | AI Security Engineer (Full Specification)

> Complete technical documentation, security model, and API specs for Securiq — Autonomous Cloud Remediation Platform.

## System Architecture

Securiq functions as an AI Security Engineer for cloud infrastructure estates across AWS, GCP, Azure, and GitHub. The engine combines fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) with static analysis and dry-run infrastructure simulation to detect, investigate, and repair cloud security drifts without human manual intervention.

### 1. Ingestion & Threat Detection
Securiq ingests native telemetry from AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, and code repository scanners. Findings are prioritized by runtime blast-radius and true threat exposure rather than raw alert volume.

### 2. Context-Aware Investigation
Securiq maps findings back to the exact Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform HCL) lines responsible for the misconfiguration.

### 3. Automated Patch Synthesis
Securiq generates syntactically valid, formatted HCL Terraform pull requests ready for review.

### 4. Zero Standing Access & Security Posture
- Ephemeral OIDC authentication with zero standing credentials stored.
- Strictly read-only access to infrastructure configuration metadata.
- Zero access to customer data plane, S3 bucket contents, or database records.
- Human-in-the-loop requirement for all production executions.
